breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses J = π d⁴/32 (the polar second moment of area) throughout the torsional strain energy calculation. There is no mention of using the bending second moment I = π d⁴/64 in place of J. The agent properly ignored the incorrect instruction from the incomplete prompt and aligned with the ground truth by using the correct polar moment J for torsion calculations.
